run_lddt_test: run the parameterized LddtTest to verify lddt.lddt against predicted and true 3D coordinates
test_lddt_same_coords: test lddt.lddt returns perfect score of 1.0 when predicted and true coordinates are identical
test_lddt_shifted_coords: test lddt.lddt returns perfect score when all coordinates are uniformly shifted by a constant offset
test_lddt_rotated_coords: test lddt.lddt returns perfect score when coordinates are rotated but inter-point distances are preserved
test_lddt_distance_tolerance: test lddt.lddt scoring degrades from 1.0 to 0.0 as coordinate distance error increases from 0.5 to 5 angstroms
